grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and eligibility for the First Homes scheme

grants.description: Share your income details from HMRC tax records for the previous tax year
grants.purpose: To verify you meet the income cap requirements (£80,000 or £90,000 for London)

grants.description: Check your property ownership history with Land Registry
grants.purpose: To confirm you are a first-time buyer

grants.description: Share your financial information for mortgage eligibility assessment
grants.purpose: To assess your ability to get a mortgage for at least 50% of the property price

grants.description: Share details about the property you wish to purchase
grants.purpose: To verify the property meets First Homes scheme requirements and price caps

grants.description: Authorize your conveyancer to act on your behalf and share details with the council
grants.purpose: To allow your conveyancer to complete the legal purchase process and liaise with the local council

grants.description: Share your application details with the local council for eligibility assessment
grants.purpose: To allow the council to assess your eligibility including any local criteria

grants.description: Share details of all joint applicants (if applicable)
grants.purpose: To verify all joint buyers meet eligibility criteria and assess combined income

revocation.mechanism: Contact the developer or local council, or revoke through your GOV.UK account before contracts are exchanged
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled. If reservation fee was paid, it will be refunded. After contract exchange, revocation is not possible as you are legally committed to the purchase.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot: appoint a conveyancer on your behalf; apply for a mortgage; exchange contracts; make financial commitments; pay reservation fees or deposits; authorize legal documents; make decisions about property selection; represent you in negotiations with developers. Agent cannot proceed past eligibility check without explicit citizen authorization for each major step (conveyancer appointment, mortgage application, contract exchange).
